hook.name: HookpotHook
hook.description: A jackpot lottery hook for a native ETH / Hookpot token pool that charges a 1.7% fee on every buy and sell to accumulate a jackpot. Each eligible swap earns weighted tickets proportional to trade size (with per-wallet caps and penalties), and at round end a weighted-random winner is drawn who must hold a minimum Hookpot token balance.
